- [ ] Core Forge code / bug fix

> Challenge solutions and community application source should normally remain in contributor-owned repositories. Do not copy an entire external project into the Forge core repo unless maintainers explicitly request it.

## Security declaration

- [ ] I did not include secrets, credentials, private student data, or `.env` contents.
- [ ] I did not include unexplained binaries, opaque archives, or obfuscated payloads.
- [ ] I documented every new dependency.
- [ ] I documented network access.
- [ ] I documented file read/write behavior.
- [ ] I documented subprocess/system-command execution.
- [ ] I documented any required API key/credential and did not hardcode it.
- [ ] I reviewed screenshots for personal/private information.
- [ ] I understand this pull request and all external links are untrusted until reviewed.

### Network access
`None` or describe endpoints/purpose.

`None` or describe paths/purpose.

### System commands / subprocesses
`None` or describe commands/purpose.

### New dependencies
`None` or list package + reason.

### External links
`None` or list each URL and its purpose.

## Testing / validation

Explain how you validated the change without including private credentials or data. Do not instruct maintainers or students to run unknown binaries.

Confirm they contain no secrets/private data.
